ownership.P14: authoritative battle state, HP, shield, damage, outcome and event sequence
ownership.P19: HUD state, input, viewport anchors and UI lifecycle
ownership.P29: decorative event consumer, animation cancellation, presentation-only interpolation and audio cue dispatch

snapshot_recovery: On sequence gap, future epoch, resume or stale visual state, stop queue consumption and request the latest P14 snapshot through the host adapter. Replace presentation baseline; do not synthesize or replay missing events.
presentation_anchor_policy: Use only current P19 sampled source_rect/target_rect. Never infer coordinates from hand index, enemy_id or P27 visual-center proposal.

modes.normal: play optional decoration and always publish committed result facts
modes.fast: collapse decoration to terminal cue; no domain state change
modes.reduced: no travel, movement, shake, flash or scrolling numbers; static result facts only
modes.none: same persistent information as reduced, no optional animation/audio
modes.skip: cancel current visual epoch idempotently; preserve result log and domain state
